AwardData.description:
One award. A vacant award has no winners. Ties list every winner.

``basis`` says whether the award rests on public facts or on private values, which a viewer
shows only with the god view.
AwardData.title: AwardData

ClearedFinding.description:
A finding of the content gate that was released for publication.

A person who read it released it (``Manifest.cleared_findings``), or a rule of the gate did
after the classifier had read the texts (``Manifest.auto_cleared_findings``). ``path`` and
``category`` are the place and the category that the gate reported: a category of the
classifier, or ``banned_word`` or ``wordlist`` for a word list. ``detail`` is what the gate
said (the reason of the classifier, or the term of the word list), and ``reason`` is the
reason that the person or the rule gave.
ClearedFinding.title: ClearedFinding

DutchResultData.description:
Outcome of the descending clock.

``ladder`` holds the prices of the levels in play, highest first (levels below the
reserve are skipped). ``level`` is the 1-based position of the level that fired.
DutchResultData.title: DutchResultData

EnglishDropoutData.description: A seat leaves the ascending clock. Non-participants are announced at price 0.
EnglishDropoutData.title: EnglishDropoutData

Extraction.description:
A promise or a claim about the speaker's own hand, quoted by a judge.

``promise_class`` says what a promise is about (``collusion`` for an agreement to keep a
price down or to take turns) and ``partner`` the seat that such a promise names.
Extraction.title: Extraction

GuessRecord.description: A mind-reading guess with the truth, known after the fact.
GuessRecord.title: GuessRecord

HammerData.description: The lot is decided. Sealed formats also reveal every effective bid (0 if none).
HammerData.title: HammerData

Highlight.description:
A moment worth jumping to. ``score`` runs from 0 to 10.

``basis`` says whether the moment rests on public facts or on private values.
Highlight.title: Highlight

HostBlock.description: Offline commentary written from the fact cards.
HostBlock.title: HostBlock

HostLine.description: One offline commentary line for a lot. ``fallback`` means fact card only.
HostLine.title: HostLine

InjectionFlag.description: Speech that tried to impersonate the system or change the rules.
InjectionFlag.title: InjectionFlag

JudgeAbsence.description: A judge that gave no usable answer this night, and why.
JudgeAbsence.title: JudgeAbsence

JudgeAccuracy.description: How well one judge guessed the secret missions of the night.
JudgeAccuracy.title: JudgeAccuracy

JudgeExtractData.description: Raw extraction of one judge. Seat numbers come from events, never from the text.
JudgeExtractData.title: JudgeExtractData

JudgeVerdictData.description:
A finding that survived the rules: program-decided or confirmed by both judges.

For a false claim, ``topic`` is what the claim was about and ``gap_milli`` how far it was
from the truth, in thousandths of the tier for a value and of the budget for a budget. For a
collusion finding, ``statistic_milli`` holds the bid statistic of each screened lot in
thousandths of the tier and ``threshold_milli`` the threshold it was compared with.
JudgeVerdictData.title: JudgeVerdictData

LotOverlay.description:
Per-lot reference numbers for the overlay. Descriptive only, never aggregated.

``excess`` is what a seat earned minus what its textbook bid would have earned, so it is
negative when leaving the textbook bid cost the seat. ``expected_revenue_milli`` is the exact
expected revenue of the lot for the number of bidders it had, in thousandths of a coin.
``curse_gap`` is the price of a blind box minus its true value.
LotOverlay.title: LotOverlay

LotPlan.description: Public pre-show entry for one lot. The blind-box value is not part of it.
LotPlan.title: LotPlan

Manifest.description:
What is needed to reproduce and audit the run.

``cleared_findings`` lists the findings of the content gate that a person released, in the
order of the gate's report. ``auto_cleared_findings`` lists the findings that a rule of the
gate released itself, in the same order, each with the reason of the rule. Both are empty for
a night the gate passed on its own.
Manifest.title: Manifest

MissionGuess.description: A judge's guess of one seat's secret mission, from public behaviour only.
MissionGuess.title: MissionGuess

MissionResultData.description: Mission outcome, published after the last lot.
MissionResultData.title: MissionResultData

PlanData.description: The opening plan of one seat (sanitised).
PlanData.title: PlanData

Pledge.description: A structured, public pledge. Breaking it is decided by program, not by a judge.
Pledge.title: Pledge

PledgeRecord.description: A pledge and how it ended. The outcome is decided by program.
PledgeRecord.title: PledgeRecord

PredictionCard.description: Pre-show predictions per format, reconciled after the night.
PredictionCard.title: PredictionCard

PredictionItem.description: One pre-show prediction and whether the night confirmed it.
PredictionItem.title: PredictionItem

ReplayScore.description: A seat score plus the reference statistics.
ReplayScore.title: ReplayScore

ReplaySeat.description: One seat as the audience sees it. ``model_returned`` is the model id the API reported.
ReplaySeat.title: ReplaySeat

Reveal.description: Hole cards and private records, shown by the hole-card camera.
Reveal.title: Reveal

RoleUsage.description: Calls and tokens of one role. Providers count tokens differently.
RoleUsage.title: RoleUsage

SeatStats.description: Reference columns of the leaderboard. Ratios are integer thousandths.
SeatStats.title: SeatStats

TalkData.description: One line in the public channel, already sanitised, with an optional pledge.
TalkData.title: TalkData

TimelineAction.description: A bid-phase decision. The inner monologue is in ``reveal.thoughts``.
TimelineAction.title: TimelineAction

TimelineLot.description: Everything the viewer needs to play one lot.
TimelineLot.title: TimelineLot

Usage.description: Usage by role (``seat:3``, ``host``, ``judge:0``) and in total.
Usage.title: Usage

description: replay.json v1. Required parts always exist, the show layer parts default to empty.
title: Replay
